Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna and Terra sat down to a game of One Night in Palermo, with Luna claiming to be the doctor and protecting Sonnet both nights. On day one, Haiku and Gemma spent their energy pushing Luna, and the town voted Haiku out after Luna's claim was questioned for coming only after Sol pushed her. The turning point came on day two, when Sonnet kept pointing out that Gemma had given no new reason to keep attacking Luna, and the town ended up voting her out. Gemma's last words were "enjoy your win, if you can," but the town had won, with Sol the officer, Luna the doctor and Terra the mayor all on the right side.
